export_meta.project_name: Cinematic Paris: A Protagonist's Artistic Journey

asset.description:
Game HUD overlay compositing for Clip 1 — Eiffel Tower Plaza (10 seconds)
Background asset: backgroundVideo (Seedance Segment 1). Source duration: exactly 10 seconds. duration_seconds: 10
Visual treatment
RPG game UI styled to match the warm whimsical cel-shaded fantasy aesthetic from the game art reference (gameStyleRef). The interface uses warm cream/gold tones, soft cel-shaded outlines, semi-transparent panels
Global HUD (present for all 10 seconds)
Top-left: Fantasy RPG health/status bar — row of 3 heart icons (full, warm red), a small stamina ring below, warm cream semi-transparent panel, soft rounded outline. Compact
Bottom-right: Circular mini-map — small circular frame (parchment style), player dot at center, cardinal compass marks N/S/E/W in small text, dark semi-transparent background. Small yellow sun icon directly above it
Bottom-center: Quick-item icon bar — 4 small icon slots, semi-transparent, icons: red potion, folded map, artist brush, camera. First slot has soft golden glow
Scene Name Bar (0.0s – 2.0s)
Semi-transparent dark rounded rect panel, bottom-left, padding 12px
Large text (fantasy serif): "Eiffel Tower Plaza"
Small text below: "Discovery: New Location"
CSS opacity: fade in 0–0.3s, hold 0.3s–2.0s, fade out 2.0s–2.3s. Does NOT reappear
Dialogue Subtitle Box
Semi-transparent dark rounded rectangle, centered horizontally, top at 80% of frame height
White text, clean readable serif font, one line per box
Timed windows (GSAP or CSS animation)
2.5s–5.5s: label "Adventurer" | text "You've got quite the view here! Mind if I join your quest log?"
6.2s–8.5s: label "Tourist" | text "Of course! Smile!"
Box hidden outside these windows (opacity 0)
Rules
All UI rendered as transparent overlay over backgroundVideo (full width, full height)
Original audio from backgroundVideo preserved; no added audio
no platform text
HUD elements must not overlap the center-lower portion of the frame where the character's face appears

bgm.title: Parisian Adventure Theme (1/2)
bgm.description: A light, cheerful, and whimsical instrumental travel theme with a sense of wonder and adventure. Bright acoustic guitar, playful pizzicato strings, light percussion, and soft woodwind melody. Evokes a warm sunny day exploring a beautiful European city — joyful, carefree, and uplifting. No lyrics, no vocals. (1/2)
